about_the_game:
• A Retro-Inspired JRPG Adventure

Journey through a nostalgic 1990s-style world with pixel art, turn-based combat, and an emotional story full of twists and heart.

  • Meet a Heartfelt Cast

Follow Llewl, a mysterious elf girl, as she’s protected by her best friend: Sarah, a headstrong teen, and Hans, a ragamuffin who needs a boot in the backside (Grampa's words not mine).

  • Strategic Turn-Based Battles

Combat takes place on two 4x4 grids, and combined with tiered status effects and an armour system, adds a ton of strategy to gameplay.

  • Puzzle-Filled Exploration

Swim, Jump, Climb, Push, Cast Spells, and Break stuff with your hammer.  Some puzzles have a single solutions, some can be passed in a variety of ways.

  • A Beautiful Living Pixel World

The entire world changes and reacts to what's going on at all time.  A world where everyone feels alive and is the protagonist of their own story.

  • A Vast Worldwide Card Game

All throughout the world people play the beloved card game, Lane Battle Legends, can you make it all the way to the end and become the Lane Battle Champion!

  • Minigames

From throwing snowballs at flying monsters, swimming away from others, racing horses, playing a lute/guitar hero style minigame at Inns to earn cash.

  • Build Your Town

"From ashes are empires created", or in this case "a small town created."

In the quiet village of Snowton on the Northern Continent, rumours abound of elf girls mysteriously disappearing. No one knows why, or who might be responsible. But one thing is clear: Grampa, an aging Guardian, has spent years training his young apprentice, Sarah, for a single purpose—to protect the half elf, Llewl, at any cost.

Step into Llewl and the Lyre of Two Worlds, a 1990s-inspired JRPG with an action-packed story and a diverse cast of characters. As teenage Sarah, you'll navigate the trials of duty, friendship, and love in a world full of mystery and magic. With only one true goal—have fun—immerse yourself in this nostalgic adventure.
